name: Seasonal tax expert, work from home (Intuit TurboTax Canada)
summary: Intuit hires experienced tax preparers anywhere in Canada as seasonal remote employees to help TurboTax Live customers from January to April.
whatYouDo: During tax season you help TurboTax customers with their returns live, using an Intuit laptop, camera and headset. You work at least 20 hours a week in shifts of 4+ hours chosen from available slots.
appeal: Remote anywhere in Canada; Intuit supplies laptop, video camera, backdrop and headset
Official base pay $24.50–$33.50/hr (PEI/BC range) plus end-of-season performance bonus
Predictable season (Jan–Apr) suits retirees or people between jobs
watchOuts: Not entry-level: posting asks 2+ years paid tax prep and a CRA RepID; older FAQ says 3 years and 150+ returns per season
Seasonal only, no job security; older Q&A says no medical/dental/vision
Reviewers (anecdotal) say 'flexible' shifts are limited to unfilled slots
Bonus tied to customer surveys; one reviewer got a small bonus

credentials: Canadian citizen, permanent resident or valid work permit

training.notes: Older official page: about 1 full week of training including 2 full weekends.

compensation.notes: Base range listed for PEI (same for BC) on Canadian posting; pay set by province of residence; end-of-season performance bonus.

reliability.notes: Seasonal Jan–April; minimum 20 h/week. Reviewers say shift choice is limited to slots still open.

applicationSteps: Check you have the required paid tax-prep experience and a CRA RepID
Apply to the Canada seasonal tax expert posting on jobs.intuit.com (English or French-bilingual)
Complete hiring steps and ~1 week of training before the season
Work Jan–April shifts from home on Intuit-provided equipment
fitsIf: You have several seasons of paid Canadian tax-prep experience and want well-paid seasonal remote work.
notFitIf: You have no tax-prep background or need year-round income and benefits.
